page.notes: Left edge of the scan is cut off, so the first letters of several lines are missing or partly visible (e.g. "ergo", "onibus", "teris", "n vitæ", "ion tulit", "um brevitati"). I have restored only what the visible letters support. "[?]isse" at the start of the line "non debuisse" is partly hidden. "pertra-" / "[?]tandâ": the hyphen and the missing first letter of the next line are unclear; the probable word is "pertractandâ". "voluera m" is printed with a gap; read as "volueram" with a doubtful letter. "[?]missi." is partly cut off at the left edge. The word "jūrāre" carries a macron as printed. The small marks (asterisks, dots) near the bottom of the text are ornaments or stains, not text, and are left out. The printed "s" is transcribed as "s" throughout.
